creatures.name: Dewmoth

mission.heading: One Night, One Suitcase
paragraphs: New York, 1926. Under the city hides a wizard world. Its Assembly bans every dangerous creature and locks the records away in the Forbidden Creature Archives.
Tonight a swapped suitcase has set creatures loose across the city, and the Assembly wants them sealed away. Something dark is also waking below.
You are Nigel Scamper, a creature-keeper, with your new friend Jacek. Find your creatures, learn the truth and reach the Archives before time runs out. You have ten minutes.

tutorial.text: Drag to look around the room.
Tap what glows. You can read it, pick it up or turn it in your hands.
The Notebook holds everything you learn. Puzzles do not show their clues, so open it to read them.
Puzzles open in panels. Tap X to close one. Tap Pause to stop the clock.
Every puzzle you solve frees a creature. It opens the way to the next room.
You have 10 minutes. Finds earn Wonder. Wrong answers and hints cost Wonder. You get 3 hints, and Jacek says them aloud. The clock keeps running while he talks.

timeup.title: The Shade Swallows the Archives
timeup.line: The night is over. Try again.

accused.title: The Director Walks Free
accused.line: Three wrong accusations. The guards turn away and the Shade wins. Start again from the very beginning.

idle.speaker: jacek
idle.text: Try turning around. Drag to look around.

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Midnight at the harbour. Two cases, one mix-up, and a night that will change a city.

opening.speaker: jacek
opening.text: Mister Scamper, that is not my suitcase. Mine does not growl.

opening.speaker: nigel
opening.text: It is not growling. It is nervous. Please, open it very slowly.

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Find the right case. The creatures are counting on you.

hotspots.label: Red lens

card.title: Red lens
card.text: A round red glass lens in a brass ring. Hold it over a tag and the red ink shows.

hotspots.hint: It is the red glass hood of the desk lamp near the three cases.

hotspots.label: Green lens

card.title: Green lens
card.text: A round green glass lens in a brass ring. Hold it over a tag and the green ink shows.

hotspots.hint: It is the green glass paperweight on the inspection table.

hotspots.label: Customs notice

card.title: Customs notice
card.text: A creature-keeper's case shows a Bell under red glass and an Anchor under green glass. A baker's case shows a Fish under red glass.

hotspots.hint: Find the customs notice and tap its gold ring. It says which case is yours.

views.label: Side view
views.text: A rubber stamp and an ink pad. The stamp has been used a lot.

views.label: Handle
views.text: Two letters are cut into the handle: G.H.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Three suitcases, same leather, same latches. How does anyone tell them apart?

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: By their tags. Customs stamps them with ink that only special glass can show.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Special glass. Of course. Let us look for some.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: A red lens. Hold it over a tag and the red ink shows.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: A green one. This shows the other ink.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: A Bell under red and an Anchor under green. Nigel, that is you.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Two letters cut in the handle: G.H. Whoever clears cases here uses this stamp.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Hold each lens over each tag. Look for the Bell and the Anchor.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Red first, then green. I will keep watch.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: That case does not match both stamps. Check the red glass and the green glass.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Read the notice again. Your case needs a Bell under red and an Anchor under green.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Two cases show a Bell under red. Only one of them shows an Anchor under green.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Case B. It is mine.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: And mine has the Fish. At last, something simple.

conversation.speaker: narrator
conversation.text: The right case clicks open. Inside, something small and clever starts to pick the lock.

rooms.title: Inside the Case
rooms.objective: Put each creature where it belongs.

hotspots.label: Care cards

card.title: Care cards
card.text:
Twiglet loves warm huts, sleeps all night, wakes at dawn.
Hornback lives on ice floes, awake all day, asleep at night.
Pilferling likes warm kitchens, hunts at night, sleeps by day.

hotspots.hint: The care cards are a stack on the work desk.

hotspots.label: Nigel's notebook

card.title: Nigel's notebook
card.text:
1. The Veilape sleeps whenever the Pilferling is awake, and it hates the heat.
2. The Coilwing shares the Hornback's love of ice and the Pilferling's night hours.
3. The Dewmoth sleeps whenever the Coilwing is awake, and shares the Twiglet's warm hut.

hotspots.hint: Nigel's notebook lies near the cards on the work desk. Tap its gold ring.

views.label: Front
views.text: A silver-furred creature with long arms, resting on its perch.

views.label: Eyes
views.text: Look into its eyes: a tall man in a long black coat. It sees a moment ahead.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Mister Scamper, this suitcase has weather.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Six homes in one case. Each creature belongs in the right one.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: My care cards. Three of them, anyway.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Your notes talk about the ones with no card. Read them closely.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Its eyes show a tall man in a long black coat. It sees a moment ahead.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Two questions for each creature: does it need the cold, and is it awake at night?

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: And the cards and notes answer both. Got it.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: One of them is in the wrong circle. Ask the two questions again.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: The Veilape and Dewmoth have no card. Their sentences name another creature to compare with.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: The Coilwing is in both circles. The Dewmoth sleeps whenever the Coilwing is awake.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Every creature is where it belongs.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: And not one of them wants to eat me. Good.

conversation.speaker: narrator
conversation.text: The gentle creatures settle. None of them could have broken into a vault.

rooms.title: Department Store Vault
rooms.objective: Guide the Pilferling into the cage.

hotspots.label: Shiny baits

card.title: Shiny baits
card.text: Three shiny baits on a velvet tray: a coin, a blue jewel and a key. The Pilferling cannot resist them.

hotspots.hint: The baits are on a velvet tray by the brass till.

hotspots.label: Shop-boy's note

card.title: Shop-boy's note
card.text:
1. The Pilferling goes for the nearest shiny thing it can walk to. Distance is counted in steps along the floor, not in a straight line.
2. It cannot cross a counter.
3. If two shiny things are equally near, it takes the one higher up the plan, then the one further left.
4. It only steps into the cage once its pouch holds three treasures. Before that it squeezes out and the cage is wasted.

hotspots.hint: The shop-boy's note is pinned to a pillar. Tap its gold ring.

views.label: Open case
views.text: A glass case with its door left open. Rings and pearls sit in rows.

views.label: Hinge
views.text: A scrap of grey cloth is caught in the hinge. Someone in a grey coat was here.

reward.caption: The Pilferling hands over a coin.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: A shop at midnight. Nothing is lonelier, or shinier.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Her name is Pilferling. She is not stealing. She just cannot help herself.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Three shiny baits. Exactly what she cannot resist.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Nearest first, no crossing counters, and the cage only when her pouch is full. Four rules.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: A scrap of grey cloth, caught in the hinge. Someone in a grey coat was here.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: She always goes to the nearest bait. So the order we place them in decides everything.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: And the cage must be the last thing she reaches.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: She took the cage too early. Her pouch must be full first.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Count her steps from where she starts. She goes to whichever bait is nearest by walking.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Put the baits in a line next to her, so each one is the nearest after the last.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Three treasures. Pouch full. In she goes.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: She looks pleased with herself.

conversation.speaker: narrator
conversation.text: The cage clicks shut. In her pouch, something heavier than a coin.

hotspots.label: Cipher wheel

card.title: Cipher wheel
card.text:
A brass wheel with two rings of letters. The inner ring turns.

Open your Notebook to turn it over.

hotspots.hint: The cipher wheel sits on the long bar.

hotspots.label: Coded cable

card.title: Coded cable
card.text:
AOL IVF PZ RLWA VU SLCLS UPUL

It looks like nonsense. Maybe the wheel can read it.

hotspots.hint: The coded cable is under the brass telephone on the bar.

hotspots.label: Matchbook

card.title: Matchbook
card.text: Welcome to the Seven Stars Club. Our wheel turns one step for every star on our sign. Our sign has seven.

hotspots.hint: The Seven Stars matchbook tells you how far to turn the wheel. Tap its gold ring.

views.label: Front
views.text: The front of the cipher wheel. The inner ring turns.

views.label: Back
views.text: A pencil line joins A to H. Someone marked the setting.

panel.title: The wheel and the cable
panel.cable: AOL IVF PZ RLWA VU SLCLS UPUL

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Nigel, this place is full of people who are not looking at us.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Mister Gnarlsby sells secrets. We need the one in his cable.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: A cipher wheel. Two rings of letters that turn against each other.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: A cable full of nonsense. Or a message in a wheel's language.

conversation.speaker: goblin
conversation.text: Seven stars on my sign, seven steps on my wheel. Do not say I never helped.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: A pencil line joins A to H. Whoever used it last marked the setting.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Turn the inner ring seven steps. The cable should become words.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Then we read it out loud, slowly.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: The window still shows nonsense. Check how many stars the matchbook says.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Seven steps on the inner ring. Count each letter.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Read the window out loud. It names a place and a number.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: The boy is kept on Level Nine.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Level Nine. That is deep, isn't it?

conversation.speaker: narrator
conversation.text: Somewhere far below, something dark turns over in its sleep.

rooms.title: Second Salemers Hall
rooms.objective: Find who pays for the fear.

hotspots.label: Glass sheet A

card.title: Glass sheet A
card.text: A clear sheet of glass with black dots. Sheet A stays still on the table on the lamp table. Stack all three sheets and the dots add up to one picture.

hotspots.hint: Glass sheet A is on the lectern.

seals.name: Sheet A: stays still on the table

hotspots.label: Glass sheet B

card.title: Glass sheet B
card.text: A clear sheet of glass with black dots. Sheet B slides left and right on the lamp table. Stack all three sheets and the dots add up to one picture.

hotspots.hint: Glass sheet B is in the pamphlet box.

seals.name: Sheet B: slides left and right

hotspots.label: Glass sheet C

card.title: Glass sheet C
card.text: A clear sheet of glass with black dots. Sheet C slides up and down on the lamp table. Stack all three sheets and the dots add up to one picture.

hotspots.hint: Glass sheet C is in a coat pocket on a chair.

seals.name: Sheet C: slides up and down

hotspots.label: Donor ledger

card.title: Donor ledger
card.text: The ledger lists four seals and the four names that use them.

hotspots.hint: The donor ledger is on the lamp table. Tap its gold ring.

views.label: Front
views.text: A pamphlet that says every creature is a monster.

views.label: Back
views.text: In tiny print on the back: Printed on Assembly paper.

reward.caption: The Hornback charges the door open.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: A church hall with no saints. Only pamphlets.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: They think every creature is a monster. Someone is paying them to keep thinking it.

conversation.speaker: tessa
conversation.text: Nigel Scamper? Tessa Goldwell, Assembly Investigator. Somebody high up is feeding that group. Find out who.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: A sheet of glass with a few dots on it. There must be more.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Three sheets. Three pictures that are only half a picture each.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Four seals, four names. One of them paid for all of this.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Printed on Assembly paper. Not a street printer.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Slide the sheets until the dots make a picture. Then compare it with the ledger.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Stack them like a puzzle you cannot see the box of.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Sheet A never moves. Slide B left and right, and C up and down. The dots from all three sheets add up to one picture.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: You are looking for a neat, balanced picture, like a stamp. Open the ledger in your Notebook and look at the four seals.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: One seal is a diamond with an eye in the middle. Keep sliding until the dots draw it. Sheets wrap around the edges. Then tap the name that owns that seal.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: A diamond with an eye. The Hollis family.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: The Hollis family is paying for the fear.

conversation.speaker: narrator
conversation.text: The money never touched the group's hands. It came sealed, from the Assembly's own tower.

rooms.title: Archive Stacks
rooms.objective: Open the right drawer with a shadow.

hotspots.label: Registry book

card.title: Registry book
card.text:
A big book that lists every drawer in the Archives.

Open your Notebook to read its page.

hotspots.hint: The registry book is on the ladder desk.

hotspots.label: Registry page

card.title: Registry page
card.text: Subject C is kept behind the Folded Wings plate. A drawer opens only while the statuette's shadow on the wall matches its plate.

hotspots.hint: Open your Notebook, tap Clues, and use the button on the registry book to read its page.

views.label: Side
views.text: A carved Stormwing statuette on a turntable.

views.label: Base
views.text: A crest is cut into the base: a diamond with an eye. It is the Hollis crest.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Shelves as tall as a church, and not one window.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Every creature the Assembly ever banned has a drawer in here.

conversation.speaker: tessa
conversation.text: Level Nine is past the stacks. The drawers use shadows, an old Archive trick.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: The registry. It must say which drawer holds Subject C.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Folded Wings. A drawer that opens for a shadow.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: The Hollis crest, cut into the base. Someone from that family has a hand in the Archives.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: We need the statuette's shadow to look like folded wings.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Turn it, move the lamp, and keep watching the wall.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: That drawer is empty. Look for the one the registry named.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: The statuette turns four ways and the lamp sits two ways. Try them one by one.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Folded wings means the statuette is side-on and the lamp is low.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: Subject C's file. A boy, thirteen years old.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: He is not a monster. He is a child.

conversation.speaker: narrator
conversation.text: The file is short and kind. It says the dark grows with fear, and shrinks with care.

rooms.title: Obscurus Chamber
rooms.objectiveCard:
Calm the Shade.
Then show the Assembly the truth.
Then choose how it ends.

options.label: Hold out your hand to Cael
Close the Archive seal around the Shade

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Nigel, the floor is moving.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: It is not the floor. It is a boy's fear, grown too big for him.

conversation.speaker: tessa
conversation.text: I am here. The ropes are the Archive's old binding. Free them and the Shade will quiet.

conversation.speaker: nigel
conversation.text: The ropes are free. The storm is going quiet.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Look at him. He is just a boy.

conversation.speaker: graves
conversation.text: Stand away, all of you. These creatures broke into the Archives.

conversation.speaker: tessa
conversation.text: Show the guards what you found, Nigel.

conversation.speaker: tessa
conversation.text: His stamp, his key, his crest. Guards, look at the Director's own mark.

conversation.speaker: graves
conversation.text: You were never meant to get this far.

conversation.speaker: tessa
conversation.text: Nigel, your sixth note. Fear feeds the Shade. Calm quiets it.

conversation.speaker: cael
conversation.text: Please. I do not want to hurt anyone.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Two ropes cross. Move a pin so they stop.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Swap two pins that sit next to each other and watch the storm settle.

conversation.speaker: jacek
conversation.text: Put matching colours side by side, and no rope can cross another.

conversation.speaker: graves
conversation.text: Mister Scamper, those pages say nothing about me.

conversation.speaker: tessa
conversation.text: Look for the notes with his stamp, his key and his crest.

conversation.speaker: tessa
conversation.text: Three of the six notes carry the Director's mark. The other three do not.

notes.text: Your case was cleared unopened. Stamp: G.H., Security.
Every creature in the case is gentle. None could have broken into the Archives.
A brass key marked Level Nine, engraved Director G.H., was in the Pilferling's pouch.
The boy is kept on Level Nine.
The group's money comes from a purse sealed with the Hollis crest.
Subject C is a boy. Fear feeds the Shade. Calm quiets it.

calm.speaker: narrator
calm.text: Cael takes Nigel's hand. The Shade lifts from him like smoke and fades into gold light.

calm.speaker: narrator
calm.text: Tessa's guards lead Graves-Hollis away, his polished mask gone.

calm.speaker: narrator
calm.text: The Stormwing bursts from Nigel's suitcase. The ceiling opens to the night sky.

calm.speaker: narrator
calm.text: A silver rain falls over the city and washes the night from the mind of everyone without magic.

calm.speaker: jacek
calm.text: Funny. I had the strangest dream about a suitcase.

calm.speaker: narrator
calm.text: Nigel slips a silver egg into his coat. Cael waves goodbye to him.

calm.speaker: narrator
calm.text: Tessa hands Nigel a telegram. Trial in Paris. Bring the case, and Cael.

sealed.speaker: narrator
sealed.text: The Archive seal closes. The Shade is drawn into a small iron lantern and Cael sinks into a calm sleep.

sealed.speaker: narrator
sealed.text: Tessa's guards lead Graves-Hollis away, his polished mask gone.

sealed.speaker: narrator
sealed.text: The Stormwing bursts from Nigel's suitcase. The ceiling opens to the night sky.

sealed.speaker: narrator
sealed.text: A silver rain falls over the city and washes the night from the mind of everyone without magic.

sealed.speaker: jacek
sealed.text: Funny. I had the strangest dream about a suitcase.

sealed.speaker: narrator
sealed.text: Nigel slips a silver egg into his coat. Cael sleeps on.

sealed.speaker: narrator
sealed.text: Tessa hands Nigel a telegram. Trial in Paris. The lantern hums whenever Cael dreams.
